_source: docs/eras/zpm.md, 'Machine 6' and package A5 (ZPM-A5). Real: powder-in-tube and coated-conductor wire manufacture, SMES coil winding and cold testing (the same magnet factory as the LuV HTS magnet works, one tier up).
_how_it_is_used: Read by startup_scripts/grindless/zpm/magnet_works.js (the charge, shown on the controller) and server_scripts/grindless/zpm/magnet_works.js (one gtceu:naquadria_magnets recipe per entry, id grindless:naquadria_magnets/<name>, with the data key grindless_naquadria_magnets = <name> for its EMI line, and the cryostat casing's assembler recipe); by tools/analysis/test/zpm-magnet_works.test.mjs and the smoke test gg_test_zpm_magnet_works. Nothing here is repeated in code.

charge: the cold-test charge every entry with "charge": true carries, as GTM's non-consumed fluid input (notConsumableFluid, chance 0): needed in an input hatch to start, never drained, taken once whatever the overclock or the parallel hatch's copies.

recipes[]: name (the recipe's id and lang key), circuit (the programmed circuit that picks it: every entry has its own, so GTM's lookup keeps one recipe per path), itemsIn / fluidsIn (consumed), itemsOut, eut and duration (GTM's EU/t and ticks; marked (tune) in the design until the integrated bench run). The ZPM cell's output is the ZPM row's cell of tables/wireless_energy.json and the UV cell's (circuit 4, docs/eras/uv.md, package UV-A9) the UV row's, and the UHV cell's (circuit 5, docs/eras/uhv.md, package UHV-A9: four UV cells and RTAN wire) the UHV row's (their cellMadeBy names this machine); a Node test keeps the two tables in step.

wireEconomy: what GTM's own route to a URhNq2 single wire costs, read from its recipes (mixer 122,880 x 150 t for 4 dust; EBF gas variant 7,680 x 1,005 t; vacuum freezer 122,880 x 200 t; wiremill 30 x 348 t for 2 wires). The magnet works' wire recipe is checked against it: per wire, the EU must never be lower (zpm.md A5 invariant).

casing: the cryostat casing's assembler recipe. The design asks for aerogel and gold-plated copper; aerogel is package A8's (hidden until it lands), so the casing is made from what exists when the magnet works does: a frostproof casing with gold and copper plates.

recipes.name: zpm_smes_cell
recipes._why: The wireless network's ZPM cell: six of GTM's ZPM naquadria battery, 3,932,160,000 EU, above 2^31 (S0-7 proved the network stores it exactly). A naquadria block stands for the design's 'naquadria core' (no such item exists).

recipes.name: urhnq2_wire
recipes._why: Powder in the tube: the single wire without the 9,000 K blast, the freezer or the wiremill. Priced above GTM's route per wire (wireEconomy), in EU, so the shortcut buys steps, never energy.

recipes.name: hts_insert
recipes._why: The hybrid insert: a LuV HTS coil nested in URhNq2 winding, the field source of the ion implanter's magnet and the qubit fab.

recipes.name: uv_smes_cell
recipes._why: The wireless network's UV cell (docs/eras/uv.md, 'Power', package UV-A9): six of GTM's UV naquadria battery, 15,728,640,000 EU (S0-5). EnTED wire comes only from A8's powder in the tube; darmstadtium is GTM's UV hull metal; GTM's advanced SMD capacitors stand for the design's 'UV capacitors'. Cold-tested in the same helium charge as the ZPM cell.

recipes.name: uhv_smes_cell
recipes._why: The wireless network's UHV cell (docs/eras/uhv.md, 'Power' and line 29, package UHV-A9): four UV cells' worth, 62,914,560,000 EU (S0-5). Four UV cells are rewound into one: their coils stay, sixteen RTAN windings (the powder-in-tube line's circuit 4) take the UHV field, neutronium (the Mk3's) is the cryostat's wall. Cold-tested in the same helium charge as the ZPM and UV cells. VA[UHV]: one UHV energy hatch carries it.

recipes.name: uev_smes_cell
recipes._why: The wireless network's UEV cell (docs/eras/uev.md, 'Power on the wireless network', package UEV-W): four UHV cells' worth, 251,658,240,000 EU. Four UHV cells are rewound into one: their coils stay, sixteen lay superhydride windings (the (La,Y)H10 single wire, which takes the RTAN wire's place of the UHV cell) take the UEV field, lay superhydride plate is the cryostat's wall. Cold-tested in the same helium charge as the ZPM, UV and UHV cells. VA[UEV] (7,864,320): one UEV energy hatch carries it. The cell stays unobtainable until the lay superhydride line (UEV-A3) and the UHV cells' own chain are made.
